generalProvisions: This bill enacts provisions relating to ambulance membership organizations.
highlightedProvisions: This bill:<hr><ltbullet>provides that accident and health insurance does not include an ambulance membership contract;<hr><ltbullet>enacts Title 31A, Chapter 6c, Ambulance Membership Organizations;<hr><ltbullet>defines terms;<hr><ltbullet>provides that an ambulance membership organization is exempt from certain chapters of Title 31A, Insurance;<hr><ltbullet>provides the powers and duties of the commissioner of the Insurance Department (commissioner) in relation to Title 31A, Chapter 6c, Ambulance Membership Organizations;<hr><ltbullet>provides the licensing requirements for an ambulance membership organization;<hr><ltbullet>provides the license renewal process for an ambulance membership organization;<hr><ltbullet>provides that an ambulance membership organization shall submit an annual report to the commissioner;<hr><ltbullet>provides requirements for an ambulance membership organization to maintain reserve funds and a surety bond;<hr><ltbullet>provides that an ambulance membership organization may charge a fee to a member of the ambulance membership organization;<hr><ltbullet>provides an ambulance membership organization's required disclosures to the ambulance membership organization's members;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements for an ambulance membership contract;<hr><ltbullet>prohibits an ambulance membership organization from selling, offering for sale, or providing an ambulance membership contract to an individual enrolled in Medicaid;<hr><ltbullet>provides the requirements for an individual who purchases an ambulance membership contract and who subsequently enrolls in Medicaid;<hr><ltbullet>enacts marketing requirements and required disclosures for an ambulance membership organization;<hr><ltbullet>authorizes the commissioner to revoke or suspend an ambulance membership organization's license;<hr><ltbullet>provides for penalties related to a violation of Title 31A, Chapter 6c, Ambulance Membership Organizations; and<hr><ltbullet>makes technical changes.
